scope: Exploratory m1-natural single-source-receiver full three-view PAMF with reference response; source RX 1, source days 1/2/3, six identities. Three fixed arms and three matched seeds 2026092701/02/03. Main split and leo_weak excluded. Prior target results are exposed; this is not independent confirmation.
hypothesis: Use real labeled source samples from other acquisition days to provide class-discriminative anchors for physical views of accepted unlabeled source packets. This may reduce cross-day shortcut learning and complement the existing same-packet physics contrast; no performance or novelty guarantee is implied.

candidates.mechanism: Physical U fusion features contrast with six current real-L cross-day class centroids.
Physical U time, frequency, PA, signature and reference features each contrast with corresponding real-L cross-day class centroids; average the five losses.
Include both the fusion and averaged five-branch source prototype objectives.

shared: Bank uses current true labeled source batch in eval/no-gradient mode and excludes the U sample's acquisition day for every class. Normalize features and centroids; cosine class logits use the existing contrast temperature 0.2. Cross-entropy uses the existing accepted U pseudo-class, only at existing 4-of-5 branch-certified physical As slots, and skips queries without all six other-day labeled classes. Average each pair over both existing physical student views and all U slots. Add each included loss using the original Tri joint-contrast coefficient, U weight and CE normalizer, inside the existing branch-specific U/L gradient guard. No U truth, target data, additional train-mode student forward, changed PL mask or model head. One extra eval-mode source-L forward per batch is added and accounted for.
initialization: Each student continues from the exact same-setting, same-seed source-only original Tri E20, through its own E30 and fixed final E50/11100 updates. Preserve the fixed Tri time permutation and all original mechanisms, cross-day source relation, existing branch-certified physical views and fusion-plus-five-branch same-packet contrast.
controls: matched fusion-plus-branch physical contrast without prototypes
evaluation: Freeze all nine predictions before independent truth-last scoring. Evaluate clean plus six practical scenes on identical physical IDs, DURA-LU primary and DURA-L/raw secondary. Report cross-date separately from combined cross-RX and cross-both, each seed and scene, TX/RX/day and paired corrections/regressions. No test-selected checkpoint, target-based tuning or selective rerun.
success: Seek greater than 2 percentage points over matching PL in clean and each practical DURA-LU scene, and improve over Tri. Report seed and subgroup failures. A single exposed setting cannot establish performance across all settings.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --source-prototype --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
resources: N607 ordinary non-privileged account; immutable release and run; GPU 0–7, at most four observed/pending processes per GPU including other owners, conservative free-memory reservation; preserve unrelated healthy jobs.
stop_rule: Any systemic technical failure stops new dispatch while preserving healthy workers and outputs. Each real matching E20 no-query smoke must exercise selected source-U prototype loss and nonzero signature/reference gradients for every enabled component.
expected_artifacts: Nine real E20 no-query smoke results
Nine fixed E50 source models with source prototype counters
Nine frozen seven-scene predictions then independent truth-last matched seed/scene/subgroup comparisons
